Class PreLobbyPayloadMapper

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsoft.mesos.server.model.preLobby.PreLobbyPayloadMapper
public final class PreLobbyPayloadMapper extends Object
Data mapper class responsible for converting pre-lobby business objects and event metadata into network-serializable payload objects.

This class acts as a translation layer between the server model's internal states and the messages that are sent over the network to the clients. It separates serialization concerns from domain and controller logic.

      public LobbySummaryPayload summary(Lobby lobby)
      Maps a single Lobby domain model to a light-weight LobbySummaryPayload.

      Summaries are typically used to populate the lobby listing page shown to players in the pre-lobby phase before they join any lobby.

      Parameters:
      lobby - the Lobby domain object to summarize
      Returns:
      the summarized payload representation of the lobby
